main_text.p: in instituenda vitæ suæ ratione obsequitur. Commovetur animus dum respicio, quo nos delapsi simus, quomodo defluxerit omnis fortitudo nostra, ad curam carnis & vanitatum: curat quivis quæ sua, non quæ Christi aut aliorum sunt; & dum nos ipsos nimis amamus, id fit quod Christus dixit, Charitas multorum refrigescit.

Quin potius in vineam Domini intramus, nec nos pœniteat æstum diei ferre, ut mercedem æternæ quietis & refrigerij recipiamus. Quos spiritus Dei corroborat, ne parcant leoni huic sibi obvio, interemptus apum alueare fiet, mel suavissimum quo & ipsi reficiantur & Patrem suum donent suppeditaturus est.

Quum Christum aspicimus sanguinem fudantem, ut nos tartareo æstu liberaret, ne nos defatigari paululum pigeat, ut errabundas ejus oves ardore iniquitatis suæ pereuntes, sub umbram habitaculi divini congregemus: qui iniquorum manibus latus ejus transfodi videmus, ut vulneribus mundi vulnere suo medeatur, ne sanguinem ejus extillantem, quo lethales incredulorum plagas curare possumus, in terram quasi defluere patiamur.
Magna est Domini benignitas qui nos tam sacro munere dignatur: videamus ne cum qui nos sibi individuos

page.notes: Catchword-like word "viduos" at the foot right is part of the last line ("individuos"); the last line is printed "viduos" in the lower right corner, treated as a catchword position but it continues the text, so it is kept as the last line of the text. Some letters in the top lines are slightly faded. Line "iniquorum manibus latus" printed as "iniquorum"; "quu" at end of line appears as "quū" (printed as quū). Printed text "sanguinem ejus extil-lantem" and "quo lethales" read as printed. Section "videamus ne cum qui nos sibi indi-viduos" is printed with the final word "viduos" lower right, reading as "viduos" in the scan. Printed "quo" in "cum quo" reads "qui" as printed in the scan; kept as shown. Doubtful: "quā" at the start of the paragraph "Quum Christum" is read as "Quum"; "fudantem" is set with a small gap ("fudantem").
